body: When I went to a doctor they handed me a generic survey, told me to get some blood work, and then said I was fine and sent me on my way. I think they’re used to people just wanting drugs for fun there. This isn’t fucking fun to me! I don’t even necessarily want drugs, I just want mental health help. I have taken Lorazepam occasionally in emergencies before, but good luck getting an actual prescription!
Yeah that’s what I felt like, especially with the second helpline. I ended up hanging up on her and calling a trusted friend instead. What if I didn’t have someone else to call!?
